Fleetwood Town host Arsenal at Highbury Stadium in the Carabao Cup fourth round (the last 16) on Tuesday 27 October, kick-off 8pm UK. A League Two side against a club that has won eight of its last ten in all competitions looks lopsided, and our model makes Arsenal 91% to win in 90 minutes with Fleetwood on 2%.
